cleanup-control-staging.py.recovery: User-authorized deletion of verified /var/tmp control staging only; preserve current/previous and latest two packages, data/backups/logs; persistent pre-delete plan and metadata archive. No installed release discovery or deletion.

inspect-control-disk.py.recovery: Read-only filesystem sizes, project artifact metadata, Docker usage and deleted-open-file metadata; no cleanup.

verify-live-outbound-pools.py.recovery: Prefixed sources/pools/manual inventory, registered fixed catalog tags, dependent routes for acceptance grants and exact transient fixture; only empty-baseline full collection order. Runner disarms auto-sync and restores/verifies exact baseline.

install-public-setup.py.recovery: Old center config and migate schema are copied under /var/backups/migate before setup is reopened

repair-installed-lock.py.recovery: If the database still has an administrator, restore the installed lock and remove the setup token. Does not print or change database data.

inspect-control-start.py.recovery: Read-only service state and redacted recent control logs.

inspect-control-http.py.recovery: read-only control listener and setup state

verify-runtime-health.py.recovery: read-only domain, permissions, Gate heartbeat and service readiness

verify-production-interruption.py.recovery: deliberate runner termination; next acquisition must recover persistent owned baseline

deploy-release.py.recovery: installer persists backup/manifest and restores failed service startup

verify-live-rollback.py.recovery: owned installation manifest/previous release; failed-start rollback harness

uninstall-production.py.recovery: Explicit user-requested default removal, not a test fixture. Manifest preview validates application-only scope; external backups precede removal; config/data/cores retained. Persist per-host outcome; resume manually from recorded scope on failure.

inspect-pool-tasks.py.recovery: Bounded read-only task metadata without payload/result/credentials
